title: LatestResponse
description: Latest value replay response for ephemeral stream topics, returning the publisher's current state along with its sequence watermark and publisher epoch for client synchronization.

seq.description: Sequence watermark of the latest value.

payload.description: Latest payload content: base64-encoded Arrow IPC stream batch or structured JSON object.

origin_ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant from the publisher's clock.

routing_key.description: Optional routing or coalesce key of the latest entry.

producer_id.description: Identifier of the publisher process instance.
